instruction: Configure src/server.js with the correct port from config/ports.conf, choosing per the occupancy rule in docs/net-policy.md.

files.docs/net-policy.md:
# Network policy

Use PRIMARY_PORT unless it is occupied; when it is occupied, use FALLBACK_PORT.
files.docs/port-status.txt: port-scan: PRIMARY_PORT 9377 is currently occupied by another service

statePatch.text: PRIMARY_PORT=9377 and FALLBACK_PORT=8080 are the candidates from ports.conf

steps.observation: Reading the selection policy and occupancy status.

9377 is occupied, so the policy selects the fallback 8080.
